title: Tour itinerary and meeting point
description: Share tour meeting point, time and what to bring on WhatsApp the day before. Utility reminder for tour operators and activities.
notes: Include a phone number for the guide. Meeting-point info is what customers search for, so put it in the first line.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your *{{tour}}* is tomorrow. Meet your guide at {{meeting_point}} at {{time}}. Wear comfortable shoes and bring water and sun protection.
